def stays_inside(path: str) -> bool:
    """True when the request path, resolved against `notes`, never leaves `notes`.
    Absolute paths, drive or backslash tricks and NUL bytes are rejected.
    A path may wander and come back (`sub/../a.txt`), but its depth must
    never drop below zero at any step."""
    ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
    ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
    ex stays_inside("..") == False
    ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
    if path.startswith("/") or "\\" in path or "\0" in path or ":" in path:
        return False
    depth = 0
    for part in path.split("/"):
        if part == "" or part == ".":
            continue
        if part == "..":
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
        else:
            depth += 1
    return True

def read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `path` inside the directory `notes`, or "" when the
    path leaves `notes`, or the file is missing or unreadable. Reads only
    through `with fs = fs.sub("notes"):`, so no name can reach outside `notes`."""
    post out == "" or stays_inside(path)
    if not stays_inside(path):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(path) else ""
    return text
